anika: EOD async — pushed slice7 canary to 2.5% at 21:08 UTC. Initial latency looks fine but saw a small bump in rerank error rate (~0.6% over last 15m). Keeping at 2.5% for another hour and monitoring. Blocker: intermittent 502s hitting gateway on route /v1/generate, seen ~21:12-21:16 UTC. @kevin can you take a look?
kevin: on it. I see a clustered 502 pattern from the gateway logs around 21:12. Pulling stack traces now. Could be upstream model process OOM or tokenization fail — grabbing the model logs.
maria: FYI I flipped the fallback to the quantized-small reranker for critical users to avoid user-visible failures. Added rollout note in the runbook. :thumbsup:
luis: throttled incoming burst from the edge for that route (temporary). If it stabilizes, will remove throttle. Also warming KV prefix cache for slice7 to avoid cold-start tail latencies.
kevin: quick finding — some requests are hitting a tokenizer worker that had a low ulimit and was getting killed (SIGKILL). I bumped the worker ulimit and restarted the tokenizer pool. Restart triggered a few 503s during the restart window, but should be resolved.
san: can we add a short smoke check for the next 5m? I can run a small synthetic against slice7 once kevin confirms tokenizer health.
kevin: tokenizer pool healthy now. logs: `grep -i "tokenizer" /var/log/models/re-rank.log | tail -n 30` shows restarts cleared after 21:18.
anika: running smoke now (10 synthetic requests): 10/10 success, p95 latency 220ms, rerank errors 0. Re-enabling normal traffic ramp to 5% in 10m unless anyone objects.
maria: no objections. I'll keep an eye on traces and set an alert if rerank error >0.5% for 15m.
luis: removing edge throttle in 3m if metrics look steady.
deploy-bot: canary deployment (slice7 -> 2.5%) succeeded at 2026-03-18T21:08:12Z :white_check_mark:
anika: thanks all — summary for the runbook: cause = tokenizer worker ulimit, mitigation = bump ulimit + restart pool + temporary rerank fallback + edge throttle, next step = ramp to 5% at 21:30 UTC if stable. Leaving thread open for any follow-ups. :eyes:
